project_info.theme: warm beauty livestream room with lipstick matrix display wall

main_subject.description: An adult male beauty livestream host matching the authorized identity reference, with natural facial detail, expressive eyes, and an enthusiastic open-mouth presentation expression.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 beauty livestream commerce scene using the authorized adult identity reference. Show an adult male beauty host in a clean black button-down shirt, seated behind a counter and holding an open lipstick near his face while presenting it toward camera with an enthusiastic but natural expression. Fill the warm amber room behind him with a dense matrix of red, nude, pink, black, and gold lipsticks on illuminated shelves, decorative collectibles, and product signs. Add a large soft-neon sign reading OMG 买它 at the top, a matching bottom-left placard, supportive Chinese promotional signs, warm shelf lighting, subtle neon glow, realistic product highlights, and no public-figure likeness, watermark, or extra text.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, public-figure likeness, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, explicit body measurements, illegible Chinese text, misspelled signage, distorted lipstick, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, watermark, cluttered shelves, harsh lighting

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The authorized adult identity reference is required for the livestream host. Do not imitate Li Jiaqi or any other public figure. Optional lipstick, shelf, signage, room, or lighting references may replace only their named element while preserving the warm Chinese beauty-commerce setting and OMG 买它 message.
